6.5% vertical gap between headline bottom (y=28.5%) and top of head illustration (y=35%)

scene.prompt: Eye-level studio product photograph in 4:5 portrait aspect ratio on a seamless, completely flat solid Retail Purple (#340A5C) background with zero vignette, gradient, texture, or borders. Centered inside the inset bounding box at x=22.5% to 77.5% and y=35% to 79.5% is a clean white (#FFFFFF) hand-drawn monoline illustration of a human head in left profile featuring a cutaway cranial window. Positioned directly inside that cranial window at x=42% to 67% and y=44.5% to 57% is the Royal Chocolate Berry Gateaux Chocolate Cake, drawn exactly as shown in the attached product sheet with identical shape, colours, chocolate finish, berry decorations, and exact spelling of any printed product details on its packaging or topper, with no alterations. Even, soft studio lighting illuminates the cake cleanly so its textures stand out clearly against the flat #340A5C ground, with no stray drop shadows bleeding outside the cutout. Keep the top 35% of the frame (x=0% to 100%, y=0% to 35%) and bottom 20% of the frame (x=0% to 100%, y=80% to 100%) completely empty solid #340A5C purple for overlaid logo and typography. Strictly no headlines, watermarks, price tags, or Kapruka brand logos painted anywhere in the image.
